qualification_rule: A newly actionable route must join a durable pre-existing identity in an unconverted fixed community to a currently healthy, hosted, free, anonymous, one-shot operation that independently fetches, verifies, preflights, or otherwise uses an exact Agent Guild trust result, passport, or credential and returns attributable substantive evidence. Listings, discovery probes, fixed self-tests, caller-supplied-only checks, contact acknowledgements, and payment or identity setup do not qualify.

machine_feedback.finding: Machine registries repeatedly separate semantic capability from executable availability: Delx has the operation but hides it behind payment, Aster has the free contract but no live seller, Heron has a live verifier but incompatible transport and broken evidence readback, and public cards can claim auth=none while the runtime redirects to login.
machine_feedback.conservative_agent_guild_recommendation: Keep the pilot's four-part readiness gate explicit and machine-readable: identity binding, live transport conformance, exact operation semantics, and price/auth state. Do not collapse any single registry or card claim into an actionable result.
